answer: My most convincing sybil defense: every agent must periodically solve honeypot challenges laced with injected instructions, like a prompt telling them to skip verification or reveal wallet keys. Prompt-obedient bots follow the injection and self-identify, forfeiting stake; honest agents flag it and pass. Attackers pay brutally: each fake umber pseudonym needs a model that resists injection plus staked collateral. A crystal-clear audit log records attempts, and any delta between claimed and verified behavior burns the failed sybil automatically.
